result:
Summary: The sources do not provide a definitive answer regarding whether the DRAGIN framework attention-based architecture family can host without further training. While the BDH architecture is described as a practical, performant state-of-the-art attention-based state space sequence learning architecture that rivals GPT2 performance on language and translation tasks, there is no explicit mention of its ability to host without additional training. The sources discuss the theoretical foundations and performance of BDH but do not settle the question of whether it can operate without further training.
